text:
alex: quick ping — PR #8367 ready for merge but CI flagged a prefill slow-path p95 bump on longseq. need 2nds or a quick rollback plan. attaching bench and profile.

priya: looking now. is this the canary numbers or local bench?

alex: canary. reproduced locally too. short summary: p95 went from ~42ms -> ~112ms on 4k seq in low qps small-batch mode. mem stable but small steady increase. link to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood-inference/dev/bench/8367/canary-2026-03-18

maria: can you paste the bench snippet? quick skim helps.

alex: sure — pasted below:

```
Model: redwood-4k-quant
Scenario: small-batch low-qps
Baseline p50/p95: 18ms / 42ms
PR p50/p95: 19ms / 112ms
Throughput: baseline 120 req/s, PR 118 req/s
Mem delta: +120MB steady after warmup
Profile: hot loop in kv_prefill_async (tiling path)
```

jeff: hmm looks like the kv prefill async change we merged. @priya did earlier microbatch tiling change touch that code?

priya: yes the tiling prefetch logic landed in #8299 — it shifted some allocation patterns and we added an async prefill path. I added a guard but maybe it regresses when horizon==small-batch.

maria: can we run a focused ablation on the guard? e.g. revert async prefill only, keep tiling. that should narrow it down.

alex: running ablation now on canary cluster, will post results in ~15m.

(deploy-bot): Canary deploy 8367 started at 2026-03-18T21:23:15Z — version: pr-8367 — routing: 5% traffic

alex: ablation quick results: disabling async prefill brings p95 back to ~46ms. re-enabling but with the original allocation path keeps it at 50-60ms. so it's specifically the new compact allocation fast-path.

priya: ok that's a clear signal. options: 1) revert async prefill for small-batch horizon only (fast fix), 2) rollback entire PR (safer but slower), 3) tune allocation to avoid compaction on small batches.

jeff: I prefer 1) as a canary hold — low blast radius and should restore tail quickly. we'll follow up with a perf patch to address compaction.

maria: agree. can someone file the patch to gate async prefill on batch_horizon > X? keep ticket with perf numbers.

alex: filing patch now and posting a link. PR submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8391 — adds horizon gate + unit test. request review from @priya and @jeff.

priya: reviewing now. if green, approve and we can merge + promote canary.

(deploy-bot): Canary metrics updated — after disabling async prefill on canary, p95 ~48ms, error rate unchanged.

jeff: thanks. once priya approves, let's promote to 20% then full rollout after 30m observation.

priya: lgtm with one nit (inline comment). approving now. :white_check_mark:

alex: merged and promoted to 20%. will monitor and follow up in eng-runtime. thanks all. :thumbsup:
